rows.label: tlk44400084_02_msg0001
rows.name:
I hear we're starting exchanges with
other countries. Good... I won't need
to come here anymore.

rows.label: tlk44400084_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Without proper meals, I get cold, so
I come here every day to warm up.

rows.label: tlk44400084_02_msg0003
rows.name:
The water here is heated
internally, from within the
Divine Beast, so it's always warm.

rows.label: tlk44400084_02_msg0004
rows.name:
It circulates throughout the capital,
so any snow in the city melts right
away.
